# A CAD book that earns Canadian, US and Hong Kong dollars, and holds all three.
#
# The Hong Kong dollar is pegged to the US dollar between 7.75 and 7.85, and
# this book is priced through the peg rather than by a Canadian figure picked
# out of the air. With the US dollar at 1.30 throughout:
#
#     peg 7.80   a Hong Kong dollar is 1.30/7.80 = 1/6    of a Canadian dollar
#     peg 7.75                         1.30/7.75 = 26/155
#     peg 7.85                         1.30/7.85 = 26/157
#
# All three are exact, and the format writes them as the fractions they are.
#
#     2026-02-01    1,000.00 USD at 1.30           1,300.00 CAD
#     2026-03-01  146,010.00 HKD at 1/6, peg 7.80 24,335.00 CAD
#     2026-04-01    5,000.00 CAD of consulting, in Canadian dollars
#
# The book is drawn at three dates, and they ask three different questions:
#
#     2026-09-30   US dollar 1.40, peg 7.75 — a Hong Kong dollar at 28/155.
#                  **Both currencies have moved**, and by different amounts in
#                  different directions from what each cost. This is the
#                  ordinary case, and the one where a figure that mixed the two
#                  up could still come out plausible.
#     2026-11-30   US dollar 1.30, peg 7.85 — a Hong Kong dollar at 26/157.
#     2026-12-31   US dollar 1.30, peg 7.75 — a Hong Kong dollar at 26/155.
#
# **At the last two the US dollar is a control.** It is priced at what it was
# earned at, so its gain is 0.00 while the peg moves either side of 7.80 and
# the Hong Kong figure changes sign. A currency measured against another's cost
# basis could not leave that zero standing.
#
# The 1.40 price sits at 2026-09-30 so that a sheet drawn at 2026-11-30 still
# finds the year end's 1.30 nearer — 31 days against 61 — and the two control
# dates are undisturbed by it.
#
# `some_of_the_cad_usd_and_hkd_spent.txt` spends part of each.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

	mnemonic: "HKD"
	fullname: "Hong Kong Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
